player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay {role} oo ku jira Colonel Blotto. Hadafkaagu waa inaad ku guuleysato wareegyo ka badan kan kaa soo horjeeda. Wareeg kasta, si sax ah u qoondee {num_total_units} cutubyo ku yaal meelaha {field_names}. Ciyaaryahanka u qoondeeya cutubyo badan goobta ayaa ku guuleysta goobtaas, ciyaaryahanka ku guuleysta meelaha badan ayaa ku guuleysta wareegga. Tusaale ahaan, '[A7 B7 C6]' wuxuu u qoondeeyaa 7 cutub A, 7 B, iyo 6 C.

game_state.header_round: === GARGAASHA BLOTTO - Wareega {current_round}/{num_rounds} === Wareegyada la guuleystay - Taliyaha Alpha: {alpha_score}, Taliyaha Beta: {beta_score}

round_battle.field_result: Wareega {current_round} Taliyaha Alpha ayaa loo qoondeeyay: {p0_allocations} Taliyaha Beta ayaa loo qoondeeyay: {p1_allocations}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka wax lagu soo galo oo aan sax ahayn. Isticmaal: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Magaca goobta aan sax ahayn ((s) Meelaha saxda ah: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Dhammaan qeybinta waa inay ahaadaan tirooyin aan tabanayn.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad tukraan {num_total_units} qof. Jumlo hadda: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Taliyaha Alpha wuxuu ku guuleystey {score_0}-{score_1} kadib {num_rounds} wareeg!
outcome.winner_beta: Taliyaha Beta ayaa guuleysta {score_1}-{score_0} kadib {num_rounds} wareeg!
outcome.draw: Ciyaarta waxay ku dhamaataa {score_0}-{score_1} isku dheelitir kadib {num_rounds} wareeg!
outcome.early_winner_alpha: Taliyaha Alpha ayaa guuleystay {scores_0}-{scores_1} (ugu badnaan la gaadhay)!
outcome.early_winner_beta: Taliye Beta ayaa guuleystay {scores_1}-{scores_0} (ugu badnaan la gaadhay)!
